instruction: An ADA-style accessibility ramp: a gently sloped straight ramp deck with a level landing platform at the top, sturdy handrails with vertical posts along both sides, and a plausible shallow slope. Precise buildable proportions.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a ADA access ramp. An ADA-style accessibility ramp: a gently sloped straight ramp deck with a level landing platform at the top, sturdy handrails with vertical posts along both sides, and a plausible shallow slope. Precise buildable proportions. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
